description.zh:
区分证件国徽面和人像面 ，不传默认人像面 。

- OCR_ID_FACE （默认）：人像面

- OCR_ID_NATIONAL_EMBLEM ：国徽面
description.en:
Specifies the side of the certificate. If this parameter is not specified, the portrait side is used by default.

- OCR_ID_FACE (default): the portrait side

- OCR_ID_NATIONAL_EMBLEM: the national emblem side.

description.zh:
是否进行证脸质量检测

- T：表示需要检测
- F：表示需要检测（默认 F）
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform face quality detection on the certificate.

- T: Detection is required.
- F: Detection is not required. (Default: F).

description.zh:
卡证图片 Base64 编码。

如果您选择 IdOcrPictureBase64（照片 Base64 编码）方式传入证件照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
description.en:
The Base64-encoded card or certificate image.

If you use IdOcrPictureBase64 to pass in the certificate image, check the image size and do not pass in an excessively large image.

description.zh: 证件正面图片 文件流
description.en: The file stream of the front side of the certificate image.
The URL of the front side of the certificate image.

description.zh:
自定义 OCR 质量检测阈值模式：

- 0：系统默认
- 1：严格模式
- 2：宽松模式
- 3（默认）：关闭质量检测
description.en:
The custom OCR quality detection threshold mode. Valid values:

- 0: system default
- 1: strict mode
- 2: loose mode
- 3 (default): quality detection is disabled.

description.zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长 32 位，请确保唯一
description.en: The merchant-defined unique business ID used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique.

description.zh: 业务中自定义的用户 ID，请保持唯一
description.en: The custom user ID defined in your business. Ensure that the value is unique.

description.zh:
是否进行证件 OCR

- T：表示需要证件 OCR
- F：表示不需要
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform certificate OCR.

- T: OCR is required.
- F: OCR is not required.

description.zh:
是否开启防伪检测

- T：表示开启防伪
- F：表示关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable anti-spoofing detection.

- T: Anti-spoofing is enabled.
- F: Anti-spoofing is disabled.

title.en: China card and certificate OCR recognition (ID_OCR_MIN)
